idea-plugin.name: Model Switcher for Codex CLI
idea-plugin.description:
A tool window for Codex CLI: switch the model and reasoning effort of every active chat in one click, jump straight to a saved chat, and launch your own Codex profiles — without leaving the IDE or typing shell commands. A status bar widget shows how many tokens your Codex agents use.

Model presets

Four configurable model/reasoning slots, each with its own keyboard shortcut. Switching a preset updates every currently open Codex chat at once through the local Codex app server.

Chats

Open a new chat with the current preset, or pick any saved chat from a searchable list and resume it in an integrated terminal.

Launch profiles

For anything outside the model presets — a named Codex CLI profile, a non-default flag combination, whatever ~/.codex/config.toml knows about — add a launch profile in Settings: give it a name and the extra arguments to pass (for example --profile my-profile). It shows up as its own button in the tool window; clicking it runs codex <your arguments> in a new terminal, the same way you'd type it by hand.

Token usage

A status bar widget shows Codex token consumption: tokens per minute right now, the number of active agents, and the 24-hour and 7-day averages. Click it for this project vs. all agents. Rates are per agent (two agents read the same as one) and exclude cached input, which Codex re-sends on every step. Data is read only from Codex's local session files, without any network access.

Requirements

macOS only, with the Codex CLI installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/codex or /usr/local/bin/codex. The plugin only ever launches that local, verified executable and never sends keystrokes to the editor.

Independent tool built to work with Codex CLI. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.1.0

  • Added gpt-6.2-sol and gpt-6.2-astra as model suggestions in Settings, both with reasoning up to ultra
  • Updated the plugin description for 2.0: the active-chat-only option, the usage details and the IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 minimum

2.0.0

  • New status bar widget with Codex token usage: tokens per minute per agent right now, the number of active agents, and the 24-hour and 7-day averages. Click it for this project vs. all agents, including 30-day figures. Read only from local Codex session files
  • Redesigned Model Switcher panel: one line per model, New chat and Choose chat side by side, a calmer highlight for the selected model, Settings at the bottom, and keyboard navigation
  • Reorganized Settings: Model presets, Launch profiles and Connection sections, a narrower window, and Reset presets next to the presets; it no longer resets the app-server address

1.9.0

  • Added gpt-6.1-terra as a model suggestion in Settings

1.8.0

  • Removed gpt-5.5 from the model suggestions in Settings, dropped from Codex's own model list

1.7.0

  • Added gpt-6.1-sol as a model suggestion in Settings

1.6.0

  • Added gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna as model suggestions in Settings, for the new GPT-6 generation (gpt-6-astra was already supported)

1.5.0

  • Removed gpt-5.4-mini, dropped from Codex's own default model list

1.4.0

  • Added new model suggestions in Settings (gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4-mini) and the "ultra" reasoning level for models that support it
  • The Reasoning dropdown now only offers levels the selected model actually supports, instead of one shared list for every model
